question: The external Connect2Entertaining SDK (<BaseURL>/embed-entertaining.js, loaded by RequireScript after GetEntertainingConfig) is not a TST file, so its message protocol is unknown. Mock-phase stand-in: a local module with the interface the block uses (init, isConfigured, destroy, setSources, refreshToken) that puts one iframe with the neutral page /mock-embeds/my-entertaining.html into the connect2entertaining container and calls onReady then onComplete (no status, no total) when that iframe has loaded; setSources and refreshToken do nothing; no onAuthenticated or onError. RequireScript becomes one seam function (requireEmbed(BaseURL)) where the real script is plugged in later. OK?
evidence: Embedded_MyEntertaining.mvc.js: OnAfterFetch_GetEntertainingConfig RequireScript(BaseURL + '/embed-entertaining.js') and InitializeCalendarJS (Connect2Entertaining.embed.init); calls.md:810-811 (script and iframe <BaseURL>/embed/calendar from my-entertaining-embed-tst); dom/default.html:115 (container shown, empty); D8(b) user 2026-10-14; Embedded_FeedCMS mock page answers ready/complete on load (CR-W2F-1)
mcp: not available in this run; the SDK is external (not in TST)
options: A: stand-in completes on iframe load (as the Feed CMS mock)
B: stand-in never completes (skeleton stays until the real embed is plugged)
C: completes immediately on init without waiting for the iframe

question: Accept a parity exemption MYENT-D8B-IFRAME (same kind as FEED-CMS-D8B-IFRAME): kinds structure, layout, position; pathRegex '\[Blocks\.Embedded_MyEntertaining\]( > .*)?$'; states '^default$'. The build shows the same-size mock iframe in the connect2entertaining container; the TST capture's container was empty (block and container 390x0 in the capture vs 390x794 in the build, iframe extra in build). Pixels are equal (0.00%) because the mock page is an empty neutral surface.
evidence: migration/screens/MyEntertaining/parity/default.json (structure 1: iframe extra; layout 2: 390x0 -> 390x794); analysis/dom/default.html:115 (empty container); calls.md:811 (iframe <BaseURL>/embed/calendar requested in TST); styles/bundle.css:1195-1200 (iframe min-height calc(100vh - header)); D8(b) user 2026-10-14; FEED-CMS-D8B-IFRAME accepted 2026-10-15
options: A: accept the exemption as proposed
B: reject: the user reviews the default state instead

question: Please test this route and confirm, or tell me what to change. Decisions to confirm: D8(b) stand-in for the external SDK (Q1): `components/connect2Entertaining.ts` replaces RequireScript + `window.Connect2Entertaining`; one iframe with `/mock-embeds/my-entertaining.html` (neutral page); onReady + onComplete on iframe load; setSources / refreshToken are no-ops. Plugging the real embed = `requireEmbed(BaseURL)` loads `<BaseURL>/embed-entertaining.js` and returns its `Connect2Entertaining.embed`.; Mock config: BaseURL = app origin, Token / B2CClientId / B2CPolicy empty; AppManager_Get_UserIdToken answers IdToken "" (fictional action, never a real token).; JSUtils_Console_Log calls of the block (ready, authenticated, complete, error, failed sources) are not ported (NO-CONSOLE).; The mock page is an empty neutral surface (#f4f4f4, no label): the TST container was empty, so pixels stay equal (a visible label gave 0.19% / worst tile 13.1% in the first parity run).; Exemption MYENT-D8B-IFRAME for the iframe in state default (Q2, accepted by the user 2026-10-15).; A failing token refresh (unobserved) is only logged (`log.warn`); a failing config call leaves the skeleton, as the offline capture.; Gaps of the pack (Policy_Checker, UnsupportedVersion_Wrapper, PinCode…) belong to the shell blocks; nothing rendered here. Feature flags: clientVar:App_PIN_BiometricEnabled → not a flag (false positive): user setting for biometric unlock, kept in a client variable; behaviour built as in the original (user, 2026-10-14)

Plugging the real embed = `requireEmbed(BaseURL)` loads `<BaseURL>/embed-entertaining.js` and returns its `Connect2Entertaining.embed`.
Mock config: BaseURL = app origin, Token / B2CClientId / B2CPolicy empty; AppManager_Get_UserIdToken answers IdToken "" (fictional action, never a real token).
JSUtils_Console_Log calls of the block (ready, authenticated, complete, error, failed sources) are not ported (NO-CONSOLE).
The mock page is an empty neutral surface (#f4f4f4, no label): the TST container was empty, so pixels stay equal (a visible label gave 0.19% / worst tile 13.1% in the first parity run).
Exemption MYENT-D8B-IFRAME for the iframe in state default (Q2, accepted by the user 2026-10-15).
A failing token refresh (unobserved) is only logged (`log.warn`); a failing config call leaves the skeleton, as the offline capture.
Gaps of the pack (Policy_Checker, UnsupportedVersion_Wrapper, PinCode…) belong to the shell blocks; nothing rendered here.
